description: Read a web page as clean markdown, with the URL pre-flight verdict attached (and a viewport screenshot on request). Honors robots.txt for your user agent; flags text from risky sites as untrusted. Refunded if nothing can be read. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"url": "https://example.com"}. Returns: data: markdown, title, description, lang, canonical, final_url, http_status, content_type, words, truncated, untrusted_content, preflight{verdict, safe_to, reasons, ...}, screenshot{image_base64, ...} when asked.

screenshot.description: Also return a 1280x800 JPEG of the page

ua.description: The user agent you will fetch with; robots.txt and our bot policy are judged for it. Defaults to the User-Agent of this request.

name: read_url
title: Read a page (with verdict)
